E.g. Sheffield's top LQ sector is basic metals: its LQ of 5.13 = basic metals job count there is 5.1x higher than the Great Britain average. (BRES data is GB not UK.) - Compound Annual Growth Rate figures (just the year on year percent change taken from line-slopes through the data). Two are included: for the full 2015-2024 range, and for 2021-2024.
